scope: Read-only local branch content triage; not product approval or a complete semantic equivalence proof.
limitations: Active refs changed during collection; rows bind the observed head, not a later branch tip.
Cached remote refs are not a full live GitHub inventory. A novel commit ID does not prove unpushed source.
Blob equivalence proves retained bytes, not current gameplay adoption or feature approval.
productPaths contains at most the first eight unmatched paths and is a triage sample, not a complete diff.
No files deleted, tests run, builds performed, runtime code imported, media decoded or missing Git objects fetched.
Missing objects were listed with --missing=print. No missing object was treated as source absence.
Semantic dispositions and scoped PR ownership are recorded in remaining-branches.md; unresolved donors are preserved.
